name: FONBET
verdict: The KHL's press service names Valentin Golovanov as FONBET's managing shareholder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Russian private betting company; title partner of the KHL since 2022-23 (the championship carries the FONBET name, deal extended to 2027/28) and club partner of Avangard since 2019. Managing shareholder named by the KHL's press service; no state link and no abuse record found.
